purpose: Verify Indenter successfully submits an online booking request.
action_or_input: Indenter posts valid requisition data with all required fields.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created, booking recorded with status Pending.

purpose: Verify request is rejected when required information is incomplete.
preconditions: Indenter attempts submission with missing visitor name.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal; no booking created.

purpose: Verify request is rejected when billing responsibility is outside permitted values.
preconditions: Indenter attempts submission with invalid billing responsibility.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal; no booking created.

purpose: Verify Indenter tracks, views, and prints submitted booking details.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with booking status, dates, and printable confirmation fields.

purpose: Verify behavior when no submitted booking exists for Indenter.
preconditions: Indenter has not submitted any booking.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with empty booking list.

purpose: Verify Caretaker reviews submitted request and forwards eligible booking to VH In-Charge.
preconditions: Pending booking exists with available rooms.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=forwarded.

purpose: Verify Caretaker reviews submitted request and rejects booking directly.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=rejected and reason recorded.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge approves forwarded booking request.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=approved.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge rejects forwarded booking request.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=rejected and reason recorded.

purpose: Verify Caretaker records valid offline booking (telephonic or walk-in).
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with status=pending, is_offline=True.

purpose: Verify offline booking with incomplete information is refused.
preconditions: Caretaker enters incomplete offline booking data.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify Indenter requests booking modification before arrival.
preconditions: Approved booking exists prior to arrival date.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with updated stay duration.

purpose: Verify booking modification requested after arrival is refused.
preconditions: Booking has checked in or arrival date has passed.
expected_result: HTTP 409 Conflict / 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify Indenter requests booking cancellation before arrival.
preconditions: Approved booking exists prior to arrival.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=cancellation_requested.

purpose: Verify cancellation exactly 7 days before arrival carries 0% charge.
preconditions: Approved booking with arrival exactly 7 days from today.
expected_result: Cancellation requested with cancellation_charge_percentage=0.00.

purpose: Verify cancellation within 7 days before arrival carries 25% charge.
preconditions: Approved booking with arrival 2 days from today.
expected_result: Cancellation requested with cancellation_charge_percentage=25.00.

purpose: Verify same-day cancellation carries 50% charge.
expected_result: Cancellation requested with cancellation_charge_percentage=50.00.

purpose: Verify Caretaker allots rooms to Approved booking.
preconditions: Approved booking and active available rooms exist.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with room allotment created and occupancy recorded.

purpose: Verify room allotment is rejected if booking is not in Approved state.
expected_result: HTTP 409 Conflict / 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify Caretaker records guest check-in.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=checked_in and checkin_time set.

purpose: Verify maintaining visitor category and tariff configuration.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/vh/tariffs/ with category, occupancy, rate, effective_from.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with new TariffConfig.

purpose: Verify Caretaker records meal booking for active staying guest.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with MealBooking recorded.

purpose: Verify meal booking outside guest stay duration is rejected.
preconditions: Checked-in booking with stay Nov 1 to Nov 3.
expected_result: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity refusal.

purpose: Verify Caretaker generates bill and records offline cash settlement.
preconditions: Checked-in booking with stay and meal charges.
expected_result: Bill generated and settled with payment_mode=offline_cash.

purpose: Verify bill generation for cancelled booking includes cancellation charge component.
expected_result: Bill generated with cancellation charge line item.

purpose: Verify Caretaker maintains inventory records and threshold levels.
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with InventoryItem persisted.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge reviews and approves replenishment requirement.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=approved and approved_by set.

purpose: Verify VH In-Charge generates and views operational summary reports.
preconditions: Bookings, stays, and inventory records exist.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with report data structure.

purpose: Verify Caretaker generates and views daily reports.
preconditions: Daily occupancy and arrival data exist.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with daily occupancy records.

purpose: Verify operational role reassignment and immediate transfer of records.
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/vh/roles/reassign/ with new user_id and role_name=caretaker.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, previous role holder deactivated, new holder active immediately.

purpose: Verify Caretaker reviews and confirms booking cancellation.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=cancelled.

purpose: Verify Caretaker records guest check-out and bill verification.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with status=checked_out and checkout_time recorded.

purpose: Verify recording confirmed booking modification outcome and adjusting billing.
expected_result: Bill calculations reflect adjusted dates and room-rent total.

purpose: Verify system generates booking lifecycle notifications.
expected_result: BookingNotificationLog records corresponding events.

purpose: Verify system generates stay reminders and exception alerts (no-show, overstay).
preconditions: Stay timing passed without check-in or checkout.
expected_result: StayAlert created with alert_type no_show or overstay.

purpose: Verify no-show alert is suppressed when guest checked in on time.
preconditions: Booking checked in on arrival date.
expected_result: No no_show StayAlert generated.

purpose: Verify system generates inventory threshold alert and notification when quantity < threshold.
expected_result: is_threshold_alert becomes True and notification dispatched.

purpose: Verify no threshold alert is generated when quantity is at or above threshold.
expected_result: is_threshold_alert is False.
